title: AI’s Blind Spots: Geographic Knowledge and Diversity Deficit in Generated Urban Scenario

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic images of U.S. states, capitals, and a generic 'USA' prompt using diffusion models, extracting visual embeddings via DINO-v2, and computing Fréchet Inception Distances (FID) alongside hierarchical clustering to measure structural visual similarities and identify metropolitan-centric representation deficits.
